description: Defines a PHP class 'TemplateWysiwyg' extending 'TemplateField' for a WYSIWYG editor field in a CRM module. Includes methods to retrieve field definitions with default values and database type information.

classes.name: TemplateWysiwyg
classes.description: Represents a WYSIWYG field type for dynamic fields within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns an array defining the field's default value, database type, and inline edit capability.
